name: Craftable Coral Blocks (2x2)
summary: Lets you craft coral blocks from 2x2 squares of coral or coral fans. Useful for getting coral blocks without silk touch.

vanilla_changes.what: Coral blocks (brain, bubble, fire, horn, tube)
vanilla_changes.change: 2x2 of the matching live coral and/or coral fan (any mix of the two, via an item tag) -> 1 coral block of that type. Dead coral is not included.

getting_started: Craft in a normal crafting table (or furnace where noted); recipes appear in the recipe book once the ingredients are held.
editor_notes: Recipes accept the matching coral and coral fan interchangeably (tags coral_blocks:<type>_coral list only the live coral and live fan). Part of the bundled VanillaTweaks Crafting Tweaks datapack.
